notes.title: 🎉 1 Million Downloads!!!! Thank You!
notes.content: [p]We just hit [b]1 million downloads[/b] across all platforms for [i]Trapped with Jester[/i] and we’re absolutely blown away.[/p][p]This game was truly made with love and seeing it reach so many hearts ... and nightmares 🖤, really means the world to us. Whether you romanced Jester, ran from him, or just stuck around for the chaos... Thank you for playing and sharing the experience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997857/c71085b317368da7f58dfa2d5ca89e94476464d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Your support has been incredible and it keeps us inspired as we continue making more heartfelt, surprising, and occasionally quacking stories.[/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of which… if you enjoyed [i]Trapped with Jester[/i], you might want to keep an eye on our next title [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3574770/PreOdyssey_Love_at_First_Quack/"]Pre-Odyssey: Love at First Quack[/url], developed by the same author Anta, coming out [b]next week[/b] on Steam. It's a mythological Otome adventure packed with emotion, comedy, and yes...ducks![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997857/3039bcbc900ddfa7d9e21ad0289b886f78b688f4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your support so far, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/neoclassicgames"]follow us on Steam[/url] to get access to the latest news, events and giveaways.[/p][p][/p][p]<3 Neoclassic Games & Anta[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese Translation Update + A Certain Greek Myth-inspired Otome...
notes.content:
Hello, dev of Jester here, Anta!

It's been a while- our last update was a hefty set of language additions: French, Italian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese and Polish.

This time, Trapped with Jester has been made available in Brazilian Portuguese!

Quite a few people have actually requested for this translation, and this couldn't have been made possible without our volunteer translator, nenosuns.

As usual, to access this update, just go to SETTINGS > LANGUAGE > Scroll down for BRAZILIAN PORTUGUESE

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997857/78c92a988de297a7e6ca4e5d4e67f5414a88a815.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997857/1f6dd9070c59098dd3bb1243062974c459e94645.png[/img]

[h1]Pre-Odyssey: Love at First Quack[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997857/88382eb29a8751c219c07c22a2fefcba8ecc3a72.png[/img]

While we're at it, did you know that I'm currently developing a Greek-myth inspired otome game?

If you're looking for a cute and wholesome romance, do check out my upcoming release, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3574770/PreOdyssey_Love_at_First_Quack/]Pre-Odyssey: Love at First Quack[/url]!

Loosely based on certain Greek myths, you play as Penelope, a princess of Sparta, and her encounter with the notorious trickster king, Odysseus... but somehow, there are ducks added to the mix? What's going on? 

WISHLIST FOR UPDATES TO FIND OUT~

But don't worry, you don't have to wait too long- it will be released this June!

Follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/neoclassicgames/]our publisher page[/url] for more updates, news and events!

notes.title: French, Italian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese and Polish Translation Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It took a while, but we've implemented new language updates (French, Italian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese and Polish) for the game.

Thank you translators for making this possible! 
~RottenGod (Ukrainian), HasanH and Kivi (Turkish), Nhung Tran (Vietnamese), RiffOfBlues (Polish), Italian (Neoclassic Games) and Kiary, Asteria & Meen (French).

-And special thanks to Noel and Neoclassic Games for proofreading the French version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997857/31a821b467fe8875cc8c44ee74f3ffe20f2f97ba.jpg[/img]

Same with last time, you can access them through the settings menu, and simply pick the language of your choice. (screenshots below)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997857/8013567a3daf0b490030cdf5813d2d1d57faf82f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997857/79191fb65897cb5c5c7db0f5e05482839a6230f2.png[/img]

It's been a while, but we've also reached 1000 reviews here on Steam. 

Thank you all for the support!

notes.title: German (Deutsch), Chinese and Malaysian Translation Update
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

Thank you very much for the continued support for this little game.

I'm glad you've all enjoyed your moment with Jester!

[h1]Onto the news~[/h1]

[b]-Trapped with Jester now supports German(Deutsch), Chinese and Malay![/b]

If you haven't noticed, German was quietly added last year. 

This time, Trapped with Jester will have Chinese and Malay language options available as well.

Same with last time, you can access them through the settings menu, and simply pick the language of your choice. (screenshots below)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997857/8013567a3daf0b490030cdf5813d2d1d57faf82f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997857/e0551d47ed39df083e91e36f4b0631d2ad15fd67.png[/img]

[h1]Upcoming language update~[/h1]

[b]- A Turkish update is also currently in the works.[/b]

notes.title: Spanish+Russian Localization + Mac Update!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

First of all we wanted to thank everybody for the amazing support we got during these first 30 days after launch.
I really had a great time reading your reviews, comments and suggestions. You guys are amazing.

[h2]Some good news![/h2]
[i]
[b] - Trapped with Jester now supports Spanish(Español) and Russian(Русский)!
[/b][/i]
To access them, go to settings and pick the language of your choice. (screenshots below)

[i][b]- Also, for those who have a Mac, we prepared a game build specifically for you.[/b][/i] No need to open the game files and launch the game manually, it works perfectly from Steam.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997857/8013567a3daf0b490030cdf5813d2d1d57faf82f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997857/4ecc7e77304e37406ef6b5df2c2fb4303474933b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997857/1f98fe9bf46a75d8b55b02cd1d7dd735248ef1c7.png[/img]


If you want to support us feel free to have a look at our Trapped with Jester unique Artbook, or just follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/neoclassicgames]creator page here.[/url]


See ya!
